alternatives.title: Most four-level structured courses available on a single free online learning platform

alternatives.title: Most structured technology courses available on a single free online learning platform

alternatives.title: Most individual technology lessons available on a single free online learning platform
alternatives.assessment: Lesson-based variant. Measurable with the same audit, but lesson size varies more than course structure, so it is harder to standardise.

alternatives.title: Most technology disciplines covered by one learning platform
alternatives.assessment: Hard to standardise because 'discipline' has no fixed definition. Not pursued.

alternatives.title: Most independently operated educational websites integrated into one platform
alternatives.assessment: Not supportable: all courses are sections of one first-party website, not independent websites. Not pursued.

faq: Has Mastery Path won a Guinness World Record?
No. An application for a new record title has been submitted. Nothing has been approved or awarded.
Is Mastery Path working with Guinness World Records?
No. Anyone can apply for a record. Mastery Path is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by Guinness World Records.
Only first-party courses that pass every rule on the Quality & Verification page and have a recorded human review. One course counts once.
Are projects and quizzes counted as lessons?
No. They are counted separately, and the counts are published separately.
Can I check the numbers myself?
Yes. The course and lesson inventories, the verification report and SHA-256 checksums are linked from the Quality & Verification page, and the audit tool is in the public hub repository.
What happens if Guinness World Records says no?
Nothing changes for learners. The courses stay free, and the quality and verification work continues because it makes the library more trustworthy.
